## Technical Stack & Competencies

### Frontend Engineering
- Frameworks: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React Server Components), React 19, TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Vanilla CSS Design Systems, Accessible Semantic HTML5
- Performance: Core Web Vitals Optimization (Sub-100ms TTFB, 0 CLS, <1.2s LCP)

### Backend & API Architecture
- Runtimes: Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Celery), Go
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (In-Memory Caching & Semantic Cache), pgvector
- APIs: RESTful Services, GraphQL, Webhooks, SSE (Server-Sent Events), WebSocket Streaming

### Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Foundation LLMs: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Google Gemini 1.5 Pro, Meta Llama 3
- Vector Databases: Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector
- Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph (Multi-Agent State Graphs), LlamaIndex
- Techniques: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Caching, Prompt Injection Defense, Structured JSON Output Enforcement

### Cloud, DevOps & Security
- Cloud Providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel
- Containerization: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes
- CI/CD: Automated GitHub Actions, Pre-commit Linting, Type-Checking
- Compliance: India DPDP 2023, GDPR, SOC2-aligned architectures, Zero-Data-Retention LLM configs
